title: The Allocative Cost of War: A View to a Kill…ing of Productivity
title_zh: 战争的配置成本：生产率之殇的视角
title_primary: 战争的配置成本：生产率之殇的视角
title_secondary: The Allocative Cost of War: A View to a Kill…ing of Productivity
authors: Yuriy Gorodnichenko, Marvin Amann, Oleksandr Talavera
official: 官方在线 2026-08-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why is war so economically costly? Our answer is that modern war lowers output not only by destroying productive factors, but also by making the surviving economy work less efficiently. Using uniquely comprehensive firm-level data collected during Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, we document a dramatic collapse in allocative productivity in Ukraine. To sharpen identification and explore key mechanisms (including the role of war intensity, internal displacement, reallocation, and macroeconomic instability), we exploit spatial heterogeneity across Ukrainian districts and comparisons with Russian aggression in 2014 and the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. Our key policy implication is that restoring allocative efficiency--and preparing institutional arrangements that facilitate rapid reallocation in times of stress--is critical for sustaining economic capacity, defense, and national security.
abstract_zh: 为何战争的经济代价如此高昂？我们的答案是，现代战争不仅通过摧毁生产要素来降低产出，还使幸存经济体的运作效率下降。利用2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰期间收集的独特且全面的企业层面数据，我们记录了乌克兰配置生产率的大幅崩溃。为了强化识别并探索关键机制（包括战争强度、国内流离失所、重新配置及宏观经济不稳定的作用），我们利用了乌克兰各地区间的空间异质性，并与2014年俄罗斯侵略及2008年全球金融危机进行了比较。我们的核心政策启示是，恢复配置效率——并准备好在压力时期促进快速重新配置的制度安排——对于维持经济能力、国防和国家安全至关重要。

title: Familiar faces, honest answers? The impacts of enumerator familiarity and modality on survey responses
title_zh: 熟悉的面孔，诚实的回答？访员熟悉度与调查方式对问卷回答的影响
title_primary: 熟悉的面孔，诚实的回答？访员熟悉度与调查方式对问卷回答的影响
title_secondary: Familiar faces, honest answers? The impacts of enumerator familiarity and modality on survey responses
authors: Travis Baseler, Lipeng Chen, Thomas Ginn
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Survey data can be distorted through mistrust, discomfort, or demand effects on the part of respondents. We test whether familiar enumerators—those with whom a respondent has completed a prior survey—influence data quality in a panel survey with small business owners in Uganda. We randomly assign respondents to a familiar or a new enumerator and cross-cut a second randomization to an in-person or phone-based interview modality. Across a broad set of outcome types, we observe few impacts of either survey method on means, distributions, or attrition. However, respondents are significantly more likely to give norm-congruent answers to new surveyors compared to familiar ones. The effect of familiarity does not interact significantly with a prior experiment conducted with the same sample, suggesting that familiarity influences estimates of levels but not of treatment impacts. These findings suggest that surveys by familiar enumerators can improve the measurement of sensitive beliefs.
abstract_zh: 调查数据可能因受访者的不信任、不适或需求效应而产生扭曲。我们通过一项针对乌干达小企业主的追踪调查，检验了受访者熟悉的调查员——即受访者曾与其完成过先前调查的人员——是否会影响数据质量。我们将受访者随机分配至熟悉或陌生的调查员，并交叉进行第二次随机化，分配至面对面或电话访谈模式。在一系列广泛的结果类型中，我们观察到两种调查方法对均值、分布或流失率的影响甚微。然而，与熟悉调查员相比，受访者向新调查员给出符合规范答案的可能性显著更高。熟悉度效应与先前对同一样本进行的实验并无显著交互作用，表明熟悉度影响的是水平估计而非处理效应估计。这些发现表明，由熟悉调查员进行的调查可改善对敏感信念的测量。

title: DP19929 Value Dissonance at Work
title_zh: 工作中的价值失调：DP19929
title_primary: 工作中的价值失调：DP19929
title_secondary: DP19929 Value Dissonance at Work
authors: Alexia Delfino, Miguel Espinosa
official: 官方在线 2025-02-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Organizations often require employees to collaborate with others who may see the world differently, yet we know little about how misalignment in personal values affects performance within firms. Using survey and administrative data from a world-leading bank, we show that employees whose values diverge from those of their manager perform worse. This effect is not explained by demographic diversity or misalignment with organizational values. The productivity loss from moving from the least to the most misaligned worker is nearly four times larger than that associated with having a manager of a different gender. In contrast, value differences with teammates do not generate similar effects. We show, both empirically and theoretically, that the performance costs of value misalignment with managers can be explained by a decline in employee-led communication: fear of misunderstanding suppresses voice and information-seeking, increasing uncertainty about managerial expectations and lowering output.
abstract_zh: 组织常常要求员工与那些可能对世界持有不同看法的人合作，然而我们对于个人价值观不一致如何影响企业内部绩效知之甚少。利用一家世界领先银行的调查和行政数据，我们表明，那些价值观与其经理相左的员工表现更差。这一效应并不能由人口统计多样性或与组织价值观的不一致来解释。从最一致到最不一致的员工，其生产力损失几乎是拥有不同性别经理所带来的损失的四倍。相比之下，与团队成员之间的价值观差异并未产生类似效应。我们通过实证和理论两方面证明，与经理价值观不一致导致的绩效成本可归因于员工主导沟通的减少：害怕误解抑制了发言和信息寻求，增加了对经理期望的不确定性，从而降低了产出。

title: Violent conflicts and food insecurity coping strategies: evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 暴力冲突与粮食不安全应对策略：来自尼日利亚的证据
title_primary: 暴力冲突与粮食不安全应对策略：来自尼日利亚的证据
title_secondary: Violent conflicts and food insecurity coping strategies: evidence from Nigeria
authors: Jamilu Said Babangida, Parvinder Kler, Anita Staneva, Temesgen Kifle
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The rising incidence of conflict has raised concerns regarding the socioeconomic outcomes of affected populations. This study investigates how violent conflict shapes food insecurity coping strategies among households in Nigeria. Using a spatially merged dataset that links a longitudinal High Frequency Phone Survey (HFPS) with geocoded conflict data from the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED), we employ an instrumental variable (IV) approach to address potential endogeneity between conflict exposure and food insecurity. We instrument conflict with proximity to an international border and proximity to the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja. Our study shows that violent conflict significantly worsens household food insecurity and increases reliance on adverse food coping strategies. We further find that conflict significantly increases the likelihood of severe food insecurity among households. Urban residence, age of the household head, household employment, temperature, and precipitation are also significantly associated with food insecurity outcomes, highlighting the importance of socioeconomic, spatial, and environmental factors in shaping household vulnerability. Findings are robust across different measures of food insecurity and various sensitivity tests. Given the strong adverse effect of conflict on household food security and coping behaviour, addressing conflict-driven vulnerabilities is crucial for improving food security in affected regions.

title: World Cycles Revisited: Diverging Trends in Prices and Quantities
title_zh: 世界周期再探：价格与数量的分化趋势
title_primary: 世界周期再探：价格与数量的分化趋势
title_secondary: World Cycles Revisited: Diverging Trends in Prices and Quantities
authors: Camous, Antoine, Monnet, Eric, Puy, Damien
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We revisit evidence on world cycles using a new quarterly macrofinancial dataset covering a broad set of countries from 1950 to the COVID-19 crisis. By filling historical data gaps, we show that previous studies overstated the influence of global factors on national GDP and credit fluctuations. Our central finding is a novel disconnect: asset prices have become increasingly synchronized under financial globalization, whereas output synchronization has remained low and stable. We propose a parsimonious model in which deeper financial integration raises risk-sharing and asset-price co-movement while encouraging riskier, less correlated production structures, thereby reconciling the observed patterns.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一套覆盖1950年至新冠疫情危机期间众多国家的新季度宏观金融数据集，重新审视了关于世界周期的证据。通过填补历史数据空白，我们表明先前研究高估了全球因素对各国GDP和信贷波动的影响。我们的核心发现是一个新颖的脱节现象：在金融全球化下，资产价格日益同步化，而产出同步性则保持低位且稳定。我们提出一个简约模型，其中更深的金融一体化提升了风险共担和资产价格联动，同时鼓励风险更高、相关性更低的生产结构，从而调和了观察到的模式。

title: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
title_zh: 看似锚定的通胀预期
title_primary: 看似锚定的通胀预期
title_secondary: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
authors: Ulrike M. Malmendier, Stefan Nagel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
abstract_zh: 通常被引用的经验证据表明，通胀预期已更好地锚定，包括预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性随时间下降，尤其是在采纳通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与一种基于经验的学习模型相符，在该模型中，个体仅从自身一生中经历的实际通胀历史中学习，而不将其预期锚定于公布的通胀目标。在此模型中，新冠疫情前几十年间低短期通胀持续性的长期经历，使得长期预期对通胀意外事件不敏感，与实证锚定测试中观察到的模式相匹配。基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测也在数据中得到验证：自20世纪80年代以来，意外事件敏感性的下降在年轻个体中最为显著。对低通胀持续性经历的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升面前保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，如果个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能比普遍认为的要弱。

title: Guilt, Esteem, and Motivational Investments
title_zh: 内疚、自尊与动机性投资
title_primary: 内疚、自尊与动机性投资
title_secondary: Guilt, Esteem, and Motivational Investments
authors: Maitreesh Ghatak, Zaki Wahhaj
official: 官方在线 2020-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What are the determinants of an organization's investment in the loyalty and motivation of its workers? We develop a simple principal-agent model where the standard optimal contract is to offer a bonus that trades off incentive provision versus rent extraction. We allow the principal to undertake two types of motivational investments - one that increases the agent's disutility from deviating from a prescribed effort level, and another that increases the agent's on-the-job satisfaction. We argue that these two types of investments can capture a range of organizational practices - other than extrinsic rewards - that aim to raise worker motivation. We show that the two types of motivational investments are complements and both are substitutes to financial incentives. Our analysis implies that technological improvements in the form of improved worker productivity or greater observability of output will induce profit-maximizing firms to make greater use of financial incentives and less use of motivational investments. The reason is that while financial incentives have constant returns in terms of its effect on the worker's effort level, motivational investments by their very nature have decreasing returns.
abstract_zh: 组织对其员工忠诚度与积极性进行投资的决定因素是什么？我们构建了一个简单的委托-代理模型，其中标准最优合同是提供一种在激励提供与租金抽取之间权衡的奖金。我们允许委托人进行两类动机投资——一类增加代理人偏离规定努力水平时的负效用，另一类提升代理人的工作满意度。我们认为，这两类投资能够涵盖除外在奖励之外旨在提升员工动机的一系列组织实践。我们证明，这两类动机投资互为补充，且均与财务激励互为替代。我们的分析表明，以提升员工生产力或增强产出可观测性形式出现的技术进步，将促使追求利润最大化的企业更多采用财务激励，而减少动机投资的使用。原因在于，财务激励对员工努力水平的影响具有恒定回报，而动机投资本质上则呈现递减回报。

title: News shocks and seafood exports: Evidence from the Fukushima ALPS-treated water release announcement
title_zh: 新闻冲击与海产品出口：来自福岛ALPS处理水排放公告的证据
title_primary: 新闻冲击与海产品出口：来自福岛ALPS处理水排放公告的证据
title_secondary: News shocks and seafood exports: Evidence from the Fukushima ALPS-treated water release announcement
authors: F. Feng, Faqin Lin, Mengxun Liu, Qianqian Zhang
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: News shocks are often characterized as a form of external uncertainty, which could drive consumer behavior by shaping cognitive processes. However, news coverage often coincides with real-world events, making it difficult to identify whether observed effects are driven by the news itself or by the underlying events. Based on the announcement of the planned release of ALPS-treated water from Fukushima, news concerning future events, this paper identifies the economic consequences of news shocks and incorporates salience theory into international trade. Applying a difference-in-difference method, we find that Pacific Rim countries and regions near Japan experienced a significantly greater decrease in seafood exports than those further away in the post-news period. The negative effects could be attributed to demand-side factors, including consumer sensitivity to news, heightened fear of unknown risks, and a shift toward substitute products.

title: 数据流动、数据价值实现与福利效应
title_zh: 数据流动、数据价值实现与福利效应
title_primary: 数据流动、数据价值实现与福利效应
authors: 李世杰, 吴楚豪
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: 数据流动是数字经济的核心特征之一，厘清数据流动过程中数据价值的实现机制及其对数据产业发展的影响，对中国布局未来数字产业和培育新质生产力具有重要意义。本文通过构建一个多部门数据跨区域流动的一般均衡模型，探究数据跨区域流动在数据价值实现过程中的核心机制作用，揭示其引致要素相对价格变动与福利水平提升的传导路径。研究发现：（1）数据跨区域流动主要通过生产率赋能效应、数据规模效应和结构转型效应影响数据产业发展，其作用方向取决于数据部门间的产品替代弹性和要素产出弹性。（2）随着数据共享规模扩大，数据流入地区生产率水平显著提升，数据要素在价值实现过程中的相对价格下降，数据经济价值得到进一步释放，有助于提升数据产业福利水平。（3）随着数据交易规模扩大，数据传输成本对部门间配置结构的影响趋于一致，生产率赋能效应相对弱化；尽管结构转型可能推高数据提炼溢价，但需求驱动型数据规模效应的作用更为显著，最终降低数据提炼溢价，提升数据产业福利水平。研究表明，随着数据要素流通属性的不断增强，促进数据自由流动有助于释放数据价值，并为数据要素市场的高质量发展注入新动能。

title: Dollar Asset Holdings and Hedging around the Globe
title_zh: 全球美元资产持有与对冲
title_primary: 全球美元资产持有与对冲
title_secondary: Dollar Asset Holdings and Hedging around the Globe
authors: Wenxin Du, Amy W Huber
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We collect and analyze detailed filings from global institutional investors to estimate foreign investors’ U.S. dollar (USD) security holdings and currency hedging. Over two decades, foreign USD holdings grew sixfold, while hedge ratios rose by 15 percentage points after the 2008–2009 crisis. Currency hedging across mutual funds, pensions, and insurance reached $2 trillion by 2019. Hedging demand varies across investors, currency areas, and banking systems. We show that expected FX returns, beyond variance minimization, drive currency exposure in portfolios. Finally, we demonstrate and quantify how aggregate hedging demand affects hedging costs in the presence of constrained intermediaries. (JEL F21, F31, G11, G15, G22, G23)
abstract_zh: 我们收集并分析了全球机构投资者的详细申报文件，以估算外国投资者的美元证券持有量及货币对冲情况。在二十年间，外国美元持有量增长了六倍，而2008-2009年危机后对冲比率上升了15个百分点。截至2019年，共同基金、养老金和保险公司的货币对冲规模达到2万亿美元。对冲需求因投资者、货币区域和银行体系的不同而存在差异。我们证明，除方差最小化外，预期外汇回报率也驱动着投资组合中的货币敞口。最后，我们展示并量化了在存在受限中介机构的情况下，总对冲需求如何影响对冲成本。（JEL F21, F31, G11, G15, G22, G23）

title: Is inflation relief passed-through? Evidence from excise taxes
title_zh: 通胀减免是否传导？来自消费税的证据
title_primary: 通胀减免是否传导？来自消费税的证据
title_secondary: Is inflation relief passed-through? Evidence from excise taxes
authors: Michael D. Noel, T. Roach, Madison Hill
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The combination of ongoing pandemic-related supply chain issues and the commencement of the Ukraine-Russia war triggered a sharp increase in gasoline prices in 2022, occurring alongside a forty-year high in general inflation. In response, five state governments temporarily stopped collecting excise taxes on gasoline in order to provide ‘inflation relief’ to their constituents. In this work, we examine the incidence of this tax relief and assess whether or not the full amount was passed-through to consumers using multiple methodologies in a natural experiment setting. In aggregate, we find that excise tax pass-through was not complete with about 82% of the excise tax relief passed down to consumers, though state-level event-studies show pass-through was likely complete in two states. Our results imply an unintended subsidy to gasoline retailers of approximately $390 million dollars in exchange for only about $10–15 in savings for each driver. The results highlight the need for alternative policy measures.
abstract_zh: 疫情相关的供应链问题持续存在，加之乌克兰-俄罗斯冲突的爆发，导致2022年汽油价格急剧上涨，同时伴随着四十年来的高通胀水平。为应对此情况，五个州政府暂时停止征收汽油消费税，旨在为民众提供“通胀救济”。本研究通过多种方法，在自然实验背景下，考察了这一税收减免的归宿，并评估其是否全额传导至消费者。总体而言，我们发现消费税减免并未完全传导，约有82%的税收减免惠及消费者，尽管州级事件研究显示，其中两个州的传导可能已完全实现。我们的结果暗示，汽油零售商意外获得了约3.9亿美元的补贴，而每位驾驶者仅节省约10至15美元。这些发现凸显了采取替代政策措施的紧迫性。

abstract: Why has internal migration remained low, even as advances in communication technologies have reduced information frictions in relocation decisions? This paper develops and estimates a spatial model of mobility that incorporates status quo bias in locational preferences, multilateral search frictions, and comoving regional unemployment. Using historical proxies for search frictions, we identify and recover county-level estimates of status quo bias across the United States. Status quo bias is spatially heterogeneous and highest in states containing large urban job centers. Translating these estimates into expected-utility, geographic-distance, and state-border equivalents indicates that variation in status quo bias generates migration frictions comparable to large geographic and institutional barriers. Status quo bias also exhibits strong persistence over time, a robust relationship to migration dynamics, and associations with a range of non-wage individual- and community-level correlates of locational preferences (e.g., housing, climate, and religious and political orientations). These patterns suggest that status quo bias partly reflects place-based preferences shaped by individuals’ residential histories.

abstract: US firms hiring foreign workers in low-skill nonfarm jobs face a binding quota on the “H-2B” visa, allocated in part through a randomized lottery. authors: Kikken, Max, Künn, Steffen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务中的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这些影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据来探究这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的解法可作为任务复杂度的自然代理变量，而解题时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的当地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线PM2.5污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。

title: Data-driven persuasion
title_zh: 数据驱动的说服

authors: Maxwell Rosenthal
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a data-driven approach to Bayesian persuasion. The receiver is privately informed about the prior distribution of the state of the world, the sender knows the receiver’s preferences but does not know the distribution of the state variable, and the sender’s payoffs depend on the receiver’s action but not on the state. Prior to interacting with the receiver, the sender observes the distribution of actions taken by a population of decision makers who share the receiver’s preferences in best response to an unobserved distribution of messages generated by an unknown and potentially heterogeneous family of signals. The sender views any prior that rationalizes these data as plausible and seeks a signal that maximizes her worst-case payoff against the set of all such distributions. We show that the two-state two-action problem has a saddle point, identify a monotonicity condition on the sender’s preferences under which strong duality holds in the two-state many-action problem, and identify structural restrictions on the sender’s belief set under which strong duality holds in the two-action many-state problem. In all such cases, we identify adversarial priors and characterize robustly optimal signals.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的贝叶斯说服方法。接收者私下知晓世界状态的先验分布，发送者了解接收者的偏好但不知晓状态变量的分布，且发送者的收益取决于接收者的行动而非状态。在与接收者互动之前，发送者观察到一个决策者群体所采取行动的分布，这些决策者与接收者具有相同偏好，并对一个由未知且可能异质的信号族生成的未观测消息分布作出最优反应。发送者将任何能使这些数据合理化的先验视为可能，并寻求一种信号，以最大化其针对所有此类分布集合的最坏情况收益。我们证明，在双状态双行动问题中存在鞍点，识别出发送者偏好的单调性条件，在该条件下强对偶性在双状态多行动问题中成立，并识别出发送者信念集的结构性限制，在该限制下强对偶性在双行动多状态问题中成立。在所有这些情形中，我们识别出对抗性先验，并刻画了稳健最优信号的特征。

abstract: I derive a formula for the equilibrium distribution of markups in the search-theoretic model of imperfect competition of Butters (1977), Varian (1980), and Burdett andJudd (1983).The level of markups and the sign of the relationship between a seller's markup and its size depends on the extent of search frictions, as well as on other deep parameters.Markups are efficient.Markups are positive even though the varieties produced by sellers are perfect substitutes.Markups are heterogeneous even when all sellers operate the same production technology.Markups depend on size, even though the substitutability between a variety and the others does not depend on how much of that variety is consumed.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the monopolistic competition model of Dixit and Stiglitz (1977) would lead one to recover incorrect and unstable buyers' preferences.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the Dixit-Stiglitz model would also leads to incorrect policy recommendations.These results are a cautionary note on recent work in macroeconomics.
abstract_zh: 我推导出了在Butters（1977）、Varian（1980）以及Burdett和Judd（1983）的不完全竞争搜索理论模型中，加成率均衡分布的公式。加成率的水平及其与卖方规模之间关系的符号，取决于搜索摩擦的程度以及其他深层参数。加成率是有效率的。尽管卖方生产的品种是完全替代品，加成率仍为正。即使所有卖方采用相同的生产技术，加成率也是异质的。加成率依赖于规模，尽管某一品种与其他品种之间的替代性并不取决于该品种的消费量。若通过Dixit和Stiglitz（1977）的垄断竞争模型来解读这些加成率，将会导致恢复出不正确且不稳定的买方偏好。同样，通过Dixit-Stiglitz模型解读这些加成率，也会得出错误的政策建议。这些结果对宏观经济学领域近期的研究提出了警示。

abstract: A forward-looking agent observes signals of a state that follows a Gaussian AR(1) process. He balances the cost of having imprecise beliefs with the cost of acquiring more precise signals. I characterize his optimal information acquisition policy, and analyze how his steady-state beliefs and costs depend on persistence (the AR(1) parameter) and patience (the agent’s discount factor). Higher persistence has a non-monotone effect on belief precision and raises overall costs. Higher patience makes beliefs more precise and lowers overall costs.

abstract: Item-level transactions data yield cost-of-living indices that can account for quality change and consumer substitution. abstract: Food waste from restaurants contributes to greenhouse gas emissions and puts pressure on urban waste systems, especially in low and middle-income countries. We conducted a randomized controlled trial to assess whether food waste management training reduces kitchen-level organic waste in micro-sized and small restaurants in the hospitality industry in Cusco, Peru, a major global tourist destination. We find that the intervention reduces food waste generation by 10 percent in the trained restaurants. We also find that it improved the staff’s knowledge and awareness of food waste management practices. A simple cost-benefit analysis suggests that skills-building interventions can improve the pro-environmental performance of micro and small firms and can be implemented with a positive net benefit to society.
abstract_zh: 餐厅产生的食物浪费加剧了温室气体排放，并对城市废弃物系统造成压力，尤其是在中低收入国家。我们在秘鲁库斯科——一个全球重要的旅游目的地——开展了一项随机对照试验，以评估食物浪费管理培训是否能减少酒店业中微型和小型餐厅的厨房有机废弃物。我们发现，该干预措施使受训餐厅的食物浪费产生量减少了10%。同时，干预还提升了员工对食物浪费管理实践的知识和意识。一项简单的成本效益分析表明，技能建设干预能够改善微型和小型企业的环境友好表现，并可为社会带来正净效益。

official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-03-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Variable correlations pose significant challenges for various LASSO-type shrinkage methods in big-data modeling. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for a correlation-robust shrinkage estimator, enhancing both the theoretical and practical aspects of high-dimensional estimation. We break down the penalty term into a “shrinkage” term and a “grouping” term, illustrating its distinctive properties in clustering highly correlated variables. We establish the (non-)asymptotic properties of this estimator under relaxed assumptions regarding mixing conditions and heavier-tailed distributions. Furthermore, we demonstrate the consistency of model selection under mild conditions. Additionally, we propose a debiased version of the estimator, proving its asymptotic normality. Simulated data indicate that the debiased estimator surpasses traditional benchmarks. In an empirical application, we use this debiased estimator to identify key Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) factors that account for inflation levels. Our findings imply that news-based EPU factors are essential in explaining CPI dynamics.
abstract_zh: 变量相关性在大数据建模中对各类LASSO型收缩方法构成了显著挑战。本文提出了一个针对相关性稳健收缩估计量的综合框架，增强了高维估计的理论与实践层面。我们将惩罚项分解为“收缩”项与“分组”项，展示了其在聚类高度相关变量方面的独特性质。在关于混合条件及重尾分布的宽松假设下，我们确立了该估计量的（非）渐近性质。此外，我们证明了在温和条件下模型选择的一致性。同时，我们提出了一种去偏版本的估计量，并证明了其渐近正态性。模拟数据表明，该去偏估计量优于传统基准。在实证应用中，我们利用此去偏估计量识别了影响通胀水平的关键经济政策不确定性（EPU）因素。我们的研究结果表明，基于新闻的EPU因素在解释CPI动态中至关重要。

title: Does digital-real integration contribute to corporate ESG practices? The mediating role of dynamic capabilities
title_zh: 数字实体融合是否促进企业ESG实践？动态能力的中介作用
title_primary: 数字实体融合是否促进企业ESG实践？动态能力的中介作用
title_secondary: Does digital-real integration contribute to corporate ESG practices? The mediating role of dynamic capabilities
authors: Lulu Wang, Juan Luo
official: 官方在线 2025-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The integration of the digital economy and the real economy (IDR) plays a pivotal role in achieving sustainable economic development. Using panel data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2011 to 2022, this study empirically explores the influence of IDR on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices. Results indicate that higher IDR levels significantly enhance ESG practices. The mechanism analysis demonstrates that IDR strengthens firms’ absorptive, adaptive, and innovative capabilities, which in turn improves ESG practices. Under the ‘Technology-Organization-Environment’ (TOE) framework, executives’ information technology backgrounds, strong customer relationships, and advanced digital finance amplify IDR’s positive impact on ESG. This study contributes to understanding the micro-level implications of IDR and offers practical insights for advancing sustainable corporate transformation.
abstract_zh: 数字经济与实体经济的融合（IDR）在实现可持续经济发展中扮演着关键角色。利用2011年至2022年中国A股上市公司的面板数据，本研究实证探讨了IDR对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）实践的影响。结果表明，较高的IDR水平显著增强了企业的ESG实践。机制分析显示，IDR通过强化企业的吸收能力、适应能力和创新能力，进而改善ESG实践。在“技术-组织-环境”（TOE）框架下，高管的信息技术背景、稳固的客户关系以及先进的数字金融均能放大IDR对ESG的积极影响。本研究有助于理解IDR的微观层面含义，并为推进企业可持续转型提供了实践见解。
